agent_responses.message: Hi, this is Emma from Atlas Web Studio. I know this is out of the blue. I saw Google Maps and review listings, but I could not find a full website, so I made a free homepage mockup idea for Northside Auto Repair. Are you the owner or manager?
Yeah, I'm the owner. Uh, what's the catch?

There isn't a catch, really. It is completely free to review, and if it is not useful, you can ignore it. I just wanted to show you a homepage mockup to see if it makes your services and directions clearer for first-time customers.
So it's actually free, no strings attached? You're not gonna hit me with some subscription thing after?

No, you are not being signed up for anything. It is completely free to review, and there is no obligation. I am just offering a free homepage mockup so you can judge whether the layout and customer next step are clear enough.
Ok but if I did want an actual website built, what would that run me roughly?
Simple sites usually start around one thousand dollars. The final price depends on what you want built, but the mockup is free to review first, and there is no obligation.
Hmm, ok. So like, would having a real website actually make people trust the shop more, or is that just a sales pitch?

I can't promise that a website will automatically make people trust the shop more. However, a well-designed website can provide a clear and controlled space to present your services, directions, and other trust basics to first-time customers before they even call. It gives you an owned page to make a strong first impression.
Alright, fine. Send me the mockup link, I'll take a look.
I can send you a link. What email should I use?
It's mike at northsideauto dot com.
